title: Define runtime_contracts::ecosystem module boundary
purpose: Define which ecosystem schemas belong in runtime_contracts so other crates share stable artifact contracts.
scope: Create module boundary for manifest, registry, lockfile, verification, staging, activation and active set reports.
Prevent runtime_contracts from depending on execution crates.
Document serialization and stable hash expectations.
acceptance_criteria: No side-effect logic exists in runtime_contracts.
Schemas can be used by agent_core, security_execution, agentd and scripts.
failure_modes: Manifest fields cannot express activation requirements.
